purpose: Finite recipe audit; internal handoff, not approved clinical content
default_policy: Unknown is not low FODMAP; candidates cannot enter therapeutic weekly menus.

sources.authors: Liljebo T, Störsrud S, Andreasson A
sources.title: Presence of Fermentable Oligo-, Di-, Monosaccharides, and Polyols (FODMAPs) in commonly eaten foods
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 article; CC0 data unless credit line states otherwise
sources.attribution: Adapted selected factual table values from Liljebo et al., BMC Nutrition 6:47 (2020), doi:10.1186/s40795-020-00374-3. Normalized keys; no clinical thresholds inferred.
sources.credit_review: Read complete supplement: references identify upstream sources; no separate restrictive credit line found in supplement. Do not infer licence to unpublished full database or upstream proprietary collections.

rolled oats.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

orange.limitations: Table 1 cites refs 3/4 for fructose, ref 5 for fructan; ion chromatography shown. Variety/edible preparation unspecified. No low-FODMAP serving boundary supplied; fructan method represents selected oligomers, not necessarily all chain lengths.

pumpkin seeds.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

water.limitations: No composition measurement imported. Culinary vehicle; reviewer must confirm plain product identity. This audit does not assign numeric FODMAP zero from macronutrient assumptions.

potato.limitations: Table 1 lists Potato; source reference 2 Swedish National Food Agency; GC shown. Raw/cooked/peeled state not specified. Zero cells are reported database assignments, not proof every subtype was independently assayed or absent at every serving. Do not transfer to cooked recipe or unlimited servings.

firm tofu.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

olive oil.limitations: No composition measurement imported. Culinary vehicle; reviewer must confirm plain product identity. This audit does not assign numeric FODMAP zero from macronutrient assumptions.

white rice.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

cucumber.limitations: Table 1: GC; reference 2 accompanies fructose; glucose provenance not individually explicit. Variety, peel and preparation not specified; zero cells are compiled assignments, not separately verified measurements.

tempeh.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

quinoa.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

green lentils.limitations: Table 5: HPLC with ELSD, ref 8. Draining/cultivar not specified; no other subtype profile or threshold published in this table. Cannot extrapolate to canned lentils or classify the 40 g draft serving.

peanut butter.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

polenta.limitations: No applicable full subtype profile/serving classification established in this finite audit. Absence from selected tables is not absence of FODMAPs.

recipes.title: Warm oat and orange bowl
recipes.authorship: Original culinary draft generated for Fredheim feasibility audit; not copied from clinical recipes.
recipes.method: Simmer oats with water until tender; fold in chopped orange and top with seeds. Retain all cooking liquid.

yield.definition: Entire prepared recipe is one serving; all edible solids retained except specified draining.
yield.note: Finished weight must be measured in kitchen trial; evaporation/drainage prevents claiming input sum as cooked yield.

requirements: Use one clinically selected challenge food and subgroup initially
Start when symptoms controlled; retain appropriate trial background
Progress over approximately three days only if tolerated, according to individualized reviewed portions
Stop for unpleasant symptoms; recover for 2–3 days or until settled before next challenge
Record actual portion, preparation, timing, symptoms and contextual factors
Observed tolerance is not food composition or guaranteed meal tolerance
Never challenge known/suspected food allergy through this workflow
reintroduction.rights: Linked external context only; no copied dose table, recipe collection, image or proprietary dataset.
